verdict.rationale: Cooley GO offers jurisdiction-specific templates (UK NDA, YC Safe US/UK/Singapore versions) and Cooley's practice pages show global offices across US, Europe and Asia plus cross-border trademark and privacy capabilities, supporting multi-jurisdiction venture work. However, there is no explicit evidence of dedicated flip/redomiciliation transaction services or a documented cross-border financing workflow tying these pieces together. Missing for 10: explicit flip/redomiciliation service documentation, case studies of multi-jurisdiction financings, and integration between international offices and the document generator tools.
